title: Reusable sections for any theme
intro: Add a section to a theme with `greemo sections add demo features-slider`, or install a whole theme and choose which files render the header and footer.
code:
# List available sections
greemo sections list

# Add a section to a theme
greemo sections add <site-name> [section-name]

# Sync standardised sections to every site
greemo sections sync --force

# Install a website theme into a site
greemo theme install
